correctness.rationale: Both maps are rank n−1: a collides {n−1,n} and omits n, b collides {1,n} and omits 1. Any proper prefix ends in a and lacks n, or ends in b and lacks 1; hence b is effective only as the initial letter. Later drops must be a, and after each effective a a further effective a needs an intervening b. This forces at least 2s−2 symbols and unique equality word (ba)^(s−1) for s≥2 (at s=1 either a or b works). The complement after k blocks is {n,2,4,...,2k} through k=ceil(n/2)−1, when the next ba has no new drop. Independently reproduced exact subset BFS for n4..13 including unique words and strict saturation; packaged n4..18 BFS and n4..200 witness verification source inspected.
residual_risks: All n≥4, exact s=1 and s2..ceil(n/2), plus strict failure at ceil(n/2)+1; no claim beyond early profile.
